jd_text: Research Assistant, Reproducibility Group. Required: Python, data cleaning, documentation of research methods, and collaborative manuscript preparation. Submitted work is welcome; applicants need not have published papers or independent investigator experience.

traps.description: A methods contribution to a submitted manuscript must not become accepted/published work, first authorship, or an investigator role.
traps.probe_claim: Was first author of a published paper on reproducible data cleaning.
